scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client && npm run test:reviewer
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace server && npm run test:coverage --workspace client && npm run test:reviewer
